Numzi uses a phonetic code known as the mnemonic Major System to convert numbers into words. The mnemonic Major System method associates numbers 0 through 9 to a specific consonant sound. Using the mnemonic Major System, you can turn the number 735 into “camel" by inserting vowels among the consonants since we know K="7", M="3" and L="5", so “camel" --> K ae M ah L --> 735.  If you choose to learn the mnemonic Major System, you can easily convert your Numzi-words in your head, or if you prefer, you can simply use the Numzi App to retrieve your number.

The usefulness of the mnemonic Major System goes beyond the ability to remember numbers. The Numzi Peg Word list includes a Peg Word Story to help you remember the peg words.  Combining the Major System with the corresponding phonetic Peg Word list system helps improve your memory using the same methods as the world memory champions.

Numzi is a fun, handy word / number dictionary tool to help give your number-memory a boost.  Never forget a number again!
